review_kind: AI review; no human review performed

reviewer.independence: Reviewer did not author this validation set or implement the verifier and first inspected validation questions after this report was frozen. Stored verifier verdicts were not used as ground truth.
reviewer.study_limitations: AI-team evaluation, not an external blinded human study; reviewer saw questions, generated answers and source evidence.

generator_identity.source: Observed per-call metadata; no configured identity is substituted for an unreported provider response.

method: Read every accepted generated answer, every retained claim and its selected exact support quotes, retrieved full passages where needed, and expected_answer_checks. No environment files, provider calls or implementation edits were used.

Faithfulness assesses support and source qualification in the retrieved evidence. Citation entailment and the per-claim boolean assess all substantive clauses against selected support quotes; reasonable immediate inferences are allowed.
Relevance assesses the retained answer text, including unanswered question parts after filtering. A generic partial-answer notice does not replace the omitted answer or a specific clarification.

All accepted model answers are rated, including unexpected boundary generation VB01. Non-generated fallbacks, abstentions and pre-generation guards receive null model-quality scores and are retained in coverage/outcome notes.
Only retained generated_claims enter the claim-support denominator. Application-added caution text and verifier retention notices are not counted as model claims.
The original manual_review fields remain unscored; these annotations must remain separate from human review.
